responsibility: Implements GCC’s main language-independent diagnostic engine. This file initializes and owns diagnostic_context behavior, formats prefixes and location text, classifies and counts diagnostic kinds, applies options such as pedantic/permissive and warning-as-error handling, emits notes/paths/fix-it information through the pretty-printer, manages callbacks and final summaries, and provides the core reporting entry points and helper routines that turn rich_location plus formatted text into compiler diagnostics on stderr or other configured sinks.
same_name_distinction: Executable implementation within the diagnostic stem group: this file realizes the diagnostic subsystem behavior and reporting flow using the kinds, prefixes, and color-class names defined in diagnostic.def and the public types/APIs declared in diagnostic.h, rather than being the X-macro table or interface declaration file.
